# Purpose

Builds the PRISMA 2020 flow diagram for the systematic review
underpinning this dissertation (18 studies identified, updating
Bridge et al. 2020 to January 2017 onwards).

**Status:** run locally in RStudio, not on Barkla — this script does
not touch OPCRD data or require HPC resources. Confirmed working
12 July 2026.

```{r prisma-diagram}
#=====================================================================
# PRISMA 2020 FLOW DIAGRAM
#=====================================================================

library(PRISMA2020)

csvFile <- system.file("extdata", "PRISMA.csv", package = "PRISMA2020")
template <- read.csv(csvFile, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
template

set_n <- function(df, row_name, value) {
  df$n[df$data == row_name] <- value
  df
}

template <- set_n(template, "database_results", 4428)
template <- set_n(template, "register_results", 0)
template <- set_n(template, "duplicates", 14)
template <- set_n(template, "excluded_automatic", 0)
template <- set_n(template, "excluded_other", 0)
template <- set_n(template, "records_screened", 4414)
template <- set_n(template, "records_excluded", 4367)
template <- set_n(template, "dbr_sought_reports", 47)
template <- set_n(template, "dbr_notretrieved_reports", 0)
template <- set_n(template, "dbr_assessed", 47)
template <- set_n(template, "new_studies", 18)
template <- set_n(template, "new_reports", 18)
template <- set_n(template, "total_studies", 18)
template <- set_n(template, "total_reports", 18)

template <- set_n(
  template, "dbr_excluded",
  "EC9 - asthma control/symptom outcome rather than discrete exacerbation, 12; EC14 - etiological study without a clinical prediction model, 14; EC16 - secondary literature (review/meta-analysis/editorial), 3"
)
template[template$data == "dbr_excluded", ]

template <- set_n(template, "excluded_automatic", NA)

data <- PRISMA_data(template)
plot <- PRISMA_flowdiagram(data, previous = FALSE, other = FALSE, fontsize = 12)
plot
PRISMA_save(plot, filename = "PRISMA_diagram.png", filetype = "PNG", overwrite = TRUE)

file.exists("PRISMA_diagram.png")
```
